title: Wild Animals
text:
Lions are wild animals. They live in Africa. Lions live in groups. A group of lions is called a pride. The lions in a pride help each other.

Elephants are also wild animals. They are very big. Elephants eat grass, leaves and fruit. They can drink a lot of water every day.

questions.text: What do lions in a pride probably do together?
Why do elephants need a lot of water?
options: They like to swim in the sea

vocabulary.definition: living in nature, not kept by people
a number of animals or people together
a clear liquid that people and animals drink

paragraph_translations: Lwy to dzikie zwierzęta. Żyją w Afryce. Lwy żyją w grupach. Grupa lwów nazywa się duma. Lwy w dumie sobie pomagają.
Słonie też są dzikimi zwierzętami. Są bardzo duże. Słonie jedzą trawę, liście i owoce. Mogą wypić dużo wody każdego dnia.
